_comment: Index, sector, rates, credit, dollar, commodity and volatility ETFs the Market Risk Engine reads from market_quotes (DSN-20261031-market-risk-engine §5.1). They are always quoted, whether or not anyone holds or watches them. Builder H's read-only data audit (PR #2341) found HYG, UUP and VIXY absent from the quote universe on 2026-10-31. Operator approved design §11 item 1 in session 2026-10-31: "I approve and agree to everything one through eight…". Adding a symbol here adds one quote per refresh; nothing else changes. 2026-11-07: operator approved covering all cross-market gaps ("Approve Finviz refresh and also cover all of those other gaps"): 10 sector SPDRs, 7 industry ETFs, international, crypto, commodities, short/mid Treasuries + TIPS, REITs. 2026-11-08 (LQ-20261107-972, design WU-7, operator decision D3): EWG EWU EZU VGK join the Asia/EM proxies so the market brief's international block has a European fallback while the moomoo foreign-index lane is refused for lack of a grant/entitlement; every quote here is an ETF proxy and the brief labels it basis etf_derived, never an index level.
_sectors_comment: LQ-20261107-382, operator ask 17:55 ET 2026-11-07 ("market indicators beyond QQQ"): all 11 SPDR sector Select ETFs plus the sector/theme proxies below, so the daily-bars lane keeps a sector series that does not depend on the Finviz group table. The MRE could measure 1 of 11 sectors from institutionalised bars before this (XLK); scripts/lib/market_risk/reader.py records XLC and XLRE never having a daily bar at all. Adding a symbol here adds one quote per refresh and one daily series per bars run; nothing else changes.
_proxy_groups_comment: Sector/theme proxy map read by scripts/lib/market_event_sector_proxies.py (MarketEventSectorMoves@v1): the second sector-move source next to the MRE's Finviz-derived groups. Keys match config/market_risk_policy.yaml sectors.groups keys wherever one exists (tech, comm, discretionary, staples, healthcare, utilities, energy, financials, industrials, materials, real_estate, semis), so an affected_groups name resolves in both sources; the rest are theme keys new here. A group whose proxy has no fresh daily bar is reported UNKNOWN with its own last date, never as a flat zero.
